values.note: The agreement adds 'or, at the Dockmaster's discretion'.

season.source: https://www.ilionny.gov/qdynamo/download.php?docid=1163 (Village of Ilion Marina R.V. Site Agreement, dated 8/31/26: 'the Season is from May 01, 20__ until October 15, 20__ or, at the Dockmasters discretion') + https://www.ilionny.gov/recreation/index.php?id=408 ('will be open to RV and Campers on May 1'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Reserve with the Village's RV site agreement (linked from the marina page), deposit by check to the Village Clerk; stays of a month or less are not accepted before April 1. Daily, weekly, monthly and seasonal rentals. Questions to the Dockmaster, 315-404-6532 (cell) or 315-895-7449.

booking.source: https://www.ilionny.gov/qdynamo/download.php?docid=1163 ('the Village offers Seasonal, Monthly, Weekly, and Daily R.V. Site reservations and rentals'; 'Reservations for stays of one month or less will not be accepted before April 1') + https://www.ilionny.gov/recreation/index.php?id=408, read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.ilionny.gov/recreation/index.php?id=408 ('Each site is 28 feet wide and comes with 50 amp or 30 amp availability'; 'Each RV site includes cable and all utilities'), read 2026-10-21

sites.source: https://www.ilionny.gov/recreation/index.php?id=408 ('our beautiful Marina and RV Park with 14 sites, located on the Erie Canal'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://www.ilionny.gov/recreation/index.php?id=408 ('a bath house with showers and laundry facilities'), read 2026-10-21

note: Village of Ilion marina RV park directly on the Erie Canal; each site has cable. Transient via Dockmaster. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the village's marina page and RV site agreement (8/31/26): $50 daily (fees as read 2026-10-11), 14 sites, 50/30-amp, opens May 1, phone 315-895-7449. Added season close Oct 15, booking details, showers, laundry. Note trimmed of site count/hookups/opening and its out-of-date $37 rate. Not stated: whether 'all utilities' includes sewer (derived sewer left), Wi-Fi for RV sites (the page names wireless only for boat slips; derived wifi left), site lengths.
flags: Minor: the village rents the 14 sites seasonally ($2,000), monthly ($600) and weekly as well as daily ($50); the pages don't say how many go to seasonal campers.
